firm_data.firm_description: Morelli Law Firm is a civil litigation firm that represents individuals and families in personal injury, medical malpractice, employment discrimination, and mass tort cases. The firm was founded in 1998 by Benedict Morelli.
notable_facts: Secured over $1 billion in results for clients
Won the largest single plaintiff verdict related to sexual harassment ($95 million)
Won the largest train accident settlement related to a passenger train case ($265 million related to the 2015 Amtrak train crash)

email.subject: AI for Morelli Law Firm, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Alexander,

Your firm has secured over $1 billion in results for clients across personal injury, medical malpractice, and employment discrimination cases. That track record speaks to both your litigation strength and the complexity of cases you handle.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on document review, contract analysis, and discovery.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
